notes.area_index: Zero-based slot in the quest map's stage list. Null means the raw stage ID has no slot in that list.
notes.large_monster_tables: Stored table order. Timing and activation depend on quest logic.
notes.small_monster_setups: Setup slot 0 is initial. Other slots are alternative setups. Slots sharing one table are listed together.
notes.stored_count: Raw count byte in the spawn record. It is not a count of simultaneously active monsters.
notes.quest_script_packets: Raw four-word script instructions in file order, stored as signed 16-bit values. Runtime trigger conditions are not interpreted.
notes.scope: Checksum-valid quests stored in this DATA.BIN. Positions are spawn record coordinates. The export does not simulate patrols, respawn timing, or quests stored outside the archive.
